query:
INSERT INTO seller_profile_research_runs (
            profile_id,
            organization_id,
            workflow_run_id,
            trigger,
            status,
            requested_by_user_id,
            requested_at,
            started_at,
            finished_at,
            metadata
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            $3,
            $4,
            ($5::text)::seller_profile_research_run_status,
            $6,
            to_timestamp((($7::bigint)::double precision) / 1000.0),
            now(),
            now(),
            $8::jsonb
         )
         RETURNING id AS "id!: Uuid"
